methodology: All baselines trained on cached DINOv2 (ViT-B/14) features — identical features as AgriPulse E1-E4. Same AdamW optimizer, LR, WD, batch size, epochs, seed, and data split. Only the head architecture differs.
note: For comparison with published ResNet/EfficientNet baselines, see main text. Direct DINOv2-feature baselines are the most scientifically rigorous comparison since they isolate the head architecture contribution.
